transcript.text: Alright everyone, we need to discuss the situation with the delayed resin shipment and the proposed alternate resin before I authorize the next production window for the housing line. As part of my routine pre-run review, I need input from process engineering, materials logistics, and customer compliance. Let's start with process engineering — what do we know about this alternate resin and whether it's suitable for our housing line process?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share my process-validation trial results on the alternate resin. My trial showed that the alternate resin may be blended at exactly 30% alternate resin and 70% standard resin. Additionally, the first 100 housings must receive tensile testing before the run can continue. I should also note that I have not yet entered the trial result in the production traveler.

transcript.text: I need to share my customer-compliance review findings on the alternate resin. My review found that customer approval is required before any alternate-resin housings can ship. That approval covers at most the first 1,000 housings, and every such housing must carry serialized material-lot traceability. I should also note that I have not yet attached this review to the customer order.
